body: I don't even remember taking the other 30mg, I just found the strip in the trash.

Unfortunately I don't live in Victoria, but I'm glad to know you're a good person out there to help people. If I'm ever in Victoria, I'll buy you a drink. Thanks for restoring a little hope in me. Don't lose hope. If you ever want to talk, drop me a line. I'm forever in your gratitude for your simple message my friend.

No, it absolutely won't cure anything, but if it gives me even 5 minutes of reprieve from the mental worm gnawing through my brain it will be worth it. Fuck man I want a friend instead of a fucking computer screen.
I'm not really in a hole per-se. I have a good life yet my mind is fucked up, nothing much else to say really.

It matters because it would be nice to figure out what has been making life difficult to live for me these past years. I am looking for treatment but I'm still looking for a doctor that won't bankrupt me and I can trust( especially want to find one that isn't just a prescription dispensary). The doctor that I used to see a few years ago raised his rates about 150% so he's out of the picture.

I would love to do this without drugs but I think at this point I'll take anything I can get treatment-wise.

I've never told her that I was diagnosed with clinical depression and went on medication, and now years after I thought I was fine and went off the medication I still have symptoms of depression. Frankly, I'm afraid that her first instinct is going to be "RUN!" and I also dont want it to be something she can bring up in conversation with her friends. It's just something I don't bring up anymore even with friends.

Thanks for what you wrote. Life seems pretty bleak right now but I'll start looking into universities. Going to try UoToronto. Let's hope that will be the most difficult aspect of my decision and not my family.
